title: Intersections and Minkowski Sums of Four-Corner Cantor Dusts with the Unit Circle
summary: For $0 0$ for $\sqrt{2}-1<λ<1/2$. We also establish quantitative lower bounds for $\dim_{\rm H} E_λ$ for $λ$ near $1/2$; in particular, $\dim_{\rm H} E_λ$ approaches $1$ as $λ\uparrow1/2$. For the Minkowski sum problem, we prove that $A_λ$ has nonempty interior throughout the previously open range $1/4<λ<1/3$, answering a question of Simon and Taylor. Together with earlier results of Simon and Taylor, our theorem yields the complete classification: $A_λ$ has nonempty interior in $\mathbb{R}^2$ if and only if $1/4<λ<1/2$.
